claims.claim: Uk Used Sony PS4 Pro Console with one controller Pad
claims.evidence: Witness photos show multiple black rectangular electronic devices on a “McSteve Online Gadget Store” branded bag; no PS4 Pro console shape, disc drive, or controller is shown.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No PS4 Pro console or internal/opening indicators are visible in the photos.
Photos do not show any port testing, temperature/overheating evidence, or device power-on diagnostics.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt
claims.evidence: No controller pads or receipt are shown in the witness photos; only black rectangular gadgets on a McSteve bag are visible.

risks.risk: Item identity mismatch: photos appear to be generic black rectangular gadgets (possibly power banks/chargers) rather than a Sony PS4 Pro console.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the device showing PS4 Pro-specific features (console front with disc slot/PS logo, rear ports layout, and the model/serial label).
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown used electronic gadget (worst case: non-PS4 item / untested), not as a PS4 Pro.

risks.risk: Unknown condition and functionality (ports, charging/power, defects) because no power-on or port test is shown.
risks.proof: Video clip showing the device powered on and a port-by-port test (e.g., HDMI/USB/charging) with working indicators.
risks.if_unproven: Price as untested/possibly faulty used electronics.

risks.risk: Missing accessories and documentation (controller, cables, receipt) because none are shown.
risks.proof: Photos of everything included laid out: controller(s), power cable, HDMI cable, and the UK receipt/serial match.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console-only (or even device-only) with no accessories/receipt.

risks.risk: Potential scam/false listing: seller claims PS4 Pro with receipt, but witness photos show McSteve-branded bag and different-looking devices.
risks.proof: Photo of the PS4 Pro serial/model label and a receipt photo that matches the serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest category for the visible item type (unknown gadget) and treat PS4 Pro claim as not established.

proof_requests: Send clear photos of the actual item: front/back/side views showing PS4 Pro console identifiers (disc slot/PS logo) and the rear ports.
Send a close-up photo of the PS4 Pro model/serial label (readable).
Send a video showing power-on and a working test (ports used and any on-screen output).
Send photos of included items laid out (controller pad, power cable, HDMI cable) and a photo of the UK receipt with serial/model matching the console.
response.reason: The witness photos do not match a PS4 Pro console; they show different black rectangular gadgets on a McSteve branded bag. Without proof of the actual PS4 Pro identity and functionality, a reliable worst-case price for a PS4 Pro cannot be set.
